items.source: Service connection annotations are processed by ContainerConnectionDetailsFactory classes registered with spring.factories. A ContainerConnectionDetailsFactory can create a ConnectionDetails bean based on a specific Container subclass, or the Docker image name.

items.source: The Testcontainers library provides a way to manage services running inside Docker containers. It integrates with JUnit, allowing you to write a test class that can start up a container before any of the tests run. Testcontainers is especially useful for writing integration tests that talk to a real backend service such as MySQL, MongoDB, Cassandra and others.
items.translation: <Testcontainers> 库提供了一种管理在 Docker 容器中运行的服务的方法。它与 JUnit 集成，允许您编写一个测试类，以便在任何测试运行之前启动容器。Testcontainers 对于编写与真实后端服务（如 MySQL、MongoDB、Cassandra 等）进行通信的集成测试特别有用。

items.source: The example above will start up a Neo4j container before any of the tests are run. The lifecycle of the container instance is managed by Testcontainers, as described in their official documentation.
items.translation: 上面的示例将在运行任何测试之前启动一个 Neo4j 容器。容器实例的生命周期由 Testcontainers 管理，有关详细信息请参见其官方文档。

items.source: If you have used the annotations and extensions provided by Testcontainers, then the lifecycle of container instances is managed entirely by Testcontainers. Please refer to the official Testcontainers documentation for the information.
items.translation: 如果您使用了 Testcontainers 提供的注解和扩展，则容器实例的生命周期完全由 Testcontainers 管理。有关详细信息，请参阅官方 Testcontainers 文档。

items.source: Container beans are created and started once per application context managed by Spring’s TestContext Framework. For details about how TestContext Framework manages the underlying application contexts and beans therein, please refer to the Spring Framework documentation.
items.translation: 容器 Bean 由 Spring 的 TestContext Framework 管理的每个应用程序上下文创建并启动一次。有关 TestContext Framework 如何管理底层应用程序上下文及其中的 Bean 的详细信息，请参阅 Spring Framework 文档。

items.source: In following sections we will describe some of the methods you can use to integrate Testcontainers with your tests.
items.translation: 在以下部分中，我们将描述一些可用于将 Testcontainers 集成到您的测试中的方法。

items.source: The containers provided by Testcontainers can be managed by Spring Boot as beans.
items.translation: Testcontainers 提供的容器可以作为 Spring Boot 中的 Bean 进行管理。

items.source: You can then inject and use the container by importing the configuration class in the test class:
items.translation: 然后，您可以在测试类中导入配置类来注入并使用容器：

items.source: A common pattern with Testcontainers is to declare the container instances as static fields in an interface.
items.translation: 与 Testcontainers 常见的模式是在接口中声明容器实例为静态字段。

items.source: When you have containers declared in this way, you can reuse their configuration in multiple tests by having the test classes implement the interface.
items.translation: 当以这种方式声明容器时，可以通过让测试类实现该接口来在多个测试中重用其配置。

items.source: When the containers are managed by Spring as beans, then their lifecycle is managed by Spring:
items.translation: 当容器由 Spring 作为 Bean 管理时，其生命周期由 Spring 管理：

items.source: Container beans are created and started before all other beans.
items.translation: 容器 Bean 在创建和启动所有其他 Bean 之前被创建和启动。

items.source: Container beans are stopped after the destruction of all other beans.
items.translation: 容器 Bean 在所有其他 Bean 销毁后停止。

items.source:
This process ensures that any beans, which rely on functionality provided by the containers, can use those functionalities.
It also ensures that they are cleaned up whilst the container is still available.
items.translation: 此过程确保任何依赖容器所提供功能的 Bean 能够使用这些功能。同时，它确保在容器仍然可用时清理这些 Bean。

items.source:
Container beans are stopped as part of the TestContext Framework’s standard application context shutdown process.
When the application context gets shutdown, the containers are shutdown as well.
This usually happens after all tests using that specific cached application context have finished executing.
It may also happen earlier, depending on the caching behavior configured in TestContext Framework.
items.translation: 容器 Bean 作为测试上下文框架（TestContext Framework）标准应用程序上下文关闭过程的一部分被停止。当应用程序上下文被关闭时，容器也会随之关闭。这通常发生在所有使用该特定缓存应用程序上下文的测试执行完毕后。根据在测试上下文框架中配置的缓存行为，这也可能更早发生。

items.source: When using Testcontainers, connection details can be automatically created for a service running in a container by annotating the container field in the test class.
items.translation: 使用 Testcontainers 时，可以通过在测试类中注解容器字段来为容器中运行的服务自动创建连接详情。

items.source: This method of managing containers is often used in combination with service connection annotations.
items.translation: 这种管理容器的方法通常与服务连接注解结合使用。

items.source: You’ll need to add the spring-boot-testcontainers module as a test dependency in order to use service connections with Testcontainers.
items.translation: 若要使用 Testcontainers 的服务连接，您需要将 spring-boot-testcontainers 模块添加为测试依赖。

items.source: In most cases, you will additionally need to configure the application to connect to the service running in the container.
items.translation: 在大多数情况下，您还需要配置应用程序以连接到容器中运行的服务。

items.source: When your application beans rely on functionality of containers, prefer configuring the containers as Spring beans to ensure the correct lifecycle behavior.
items.translation: 当您的应用程序 Bean 依赖容器的功能时，请优先将容器配置为 Spring Bean，以确保正确的生命周期行为。

items.source: Having containers managed by Testcontainers instead of as Spring beans provides no guarantee of the order in which beans and containers will shutdown. It can happen that containers are shutdown before the beans relying on container functionality are cleaned up. This can lead to exceptions being thrown by client beans, for example, due to loss of connection.
items.translation: 使用 Testcontainers 管理容器而非作为 Spring Bean，无法保证 Bean 和容器的关闭顺序。 可能会出现容器在依赖容器功能的 Bean 清理之前被关闭的情况。 这可能导致客户端 Bean 抛出异常，例如由于连接丢失。

items.source: A single test container instance can, and often is, retained across execution of tests from multiple test classes.
items.translation: 单个测试容器实例可以，并且经常是，在多个测试类的测试执行期间被保留。

items.source:
A service connection is a connection to any remote service.
Spring Boot’s auto-configuration can consume the details of a service connection and use them to establish a connection to a remote service.
When doing so, the connection details take precedence over any connection-related configuration properties.
items.translation: 服务连接是到任何远程服务的连接。Spring Boot 的自动配置可以消耗服务连接的详细信息，并利用这些详细信息建立到远程服务的连接。在此过程中，连接详细信息优先于任何与连接相关的配置属性。
